name: Avoria
summary: Avoria is crafted in a choice of richly textured fabric or smooth imitation leather, each finish creating a distinct mood of elegance. Its fully upholstered form gives it a sculptural presence, while the seamless lines and tailored detailing highlight a refined attention to design. With a quiet confidence and timeless character, it brings both warmth and distinction to contemporary interiors. 67x61x96
